software.description: Aggregate-only research software that reproduces descriptive estimates, exploratory association diagnostics, tables and figures for an analysis of reported AI engagement among Romanian SME-classified responses. The package documents the reconstructed survey instrument and contains no respondent-level records.
software.title: Romanian SME AI survey analysis: aggregate reproducibility package
